_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

sb-raid.purpose: Shadow Bolt spam: DS/Ruin sacrifices the Succubus for +15% Shadow; SM/Ruin keeps the pet and takes Shadow Mastery; Life Tap is the mana.
constraints: 'Improved Life Tap is absolutely required for raiding as Life Tap is your main source of mana during fights'
the 21 Demonology points of DS/Ruin buy Demonic Sacrifice; Fel Stamina/Intellect are its fillers ('they provide no benefits')
Fel Domination is 'effectively a defensive cooldown'

Fel Stamina.why: 'Fel Stamina & Unholy Power... provide no benefits' - Demonology tier filler on the way to Demonic Sacrifice.

Fel Domination.why: 'Quite useful since it effectively gives you a defensive cooldown when you need it' (instant re-summon).

Destructive Reach.why: Range: cast from outside cleave/AoE (Classic tooltip has no threat reduction).

Demonic Embrace.why: Stamina: survivability on AoE mechanics; no DPS.

Improved Life Tap.why: 'Absolutely required for raiding as Life Tap is your main source of mana during fights.'

Suppression.why: 'Only if you do not have an assigned curse and if you are not going to be allowed to use Corruption.'

Improved Shadow Bolt.why: Brings improved shadow bolt to 3 others (a target debuff (four charges of +20% shadow damage): three other warlocks share the charges, so the simulator's permanent debuff is an upper bound); worth classic-era: +8.7% per receiver (buff_value.py).

Improved Healthstone.why: Demonology tier-1 path of the DS/Ruin build toward Demonic Sacrifice (21 points); no throughput.

Master Summoner.why: Demonology tier-2 path of the DS/Ruin build toward Demonic Sacrifice; faster and cheaper summons only.

affliction-leveling.purpose: Voidwalker tanks, DoTs tick, Drain Life heals you: no downtime as long as the pet holds threat.
loop: Life Tap, Health Funnel between pulls
constraints: pet damage is pet threat (model: pet_dmg_to_surv): Unholy Power and Fel Stamina keep the mobs on the Voidwalker
Drain Life is both damage and the health that funds Life Tap

Fel Intellect.why: Voidwalker mana for Torment/Sacrifice; tier filler.

Improved Shadow Bolt.why: Shadow Bolt crits raise the target's shadow damage taken from you by 20% for 12 s (beta): the Destruction tier-1 path of the leveling draft toward Bane; small while leveling because Shadow Bolt is a quarter of the leveling damage.

Fel Concentration.why: 70% pushback resistance on Drains and Wrack (beta): keeps Drain Life channels whole while a mob is on you.

Wrack.why: 36 shadow damage per second plus +10% damage from your other shadow DoTs (beta): the Affliction 31-point DoT of the leveling loop (Drain Hope renamed); the fight lab's warlock module casts it.

Shadow Mastery.why: +2%/rank shadow damage (beta): the Affliction tier-6 path to Wrack; 0.33%/point while leveling because a third of the leveling damage is the Voidwalker and the wand.
